## KaliScriber 0.3.7

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Fix
- **Crash about a minute into on-device speaker detection.** The speech library reports progress by calling a method it looks up by its exact signature, and the app's progress handler didn't have that method, so Android aborted the app. The handler now has the method the library expects. Before releasing, the fix was run against the same speech library on a computer, including both progress reporting and voiceprints.
